DS 3000 — Foundations of Data Science | prerequisites, offerings, professors (Northeastern)

NU Map is an independent, student-built planner — not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data comes from the public catalog on a schedule; confirm with the official catalog and an advisor.

4 semester hoursUndergraduateLectureNUpath ADNUpath NDusually offered: fall, spring, summerBostonOnlineOnlineTraditional

Introduces methods and concepts from linear algebra and probability that form a basis for modern machine learning. Emphasizes computational aspects using the Python programming language (the course assumes familiarity with Python). Students work with tensors (in NumPy) and may be tasked with implementing from scratch algorithms central to numerical linear algebra and introductory machine learning.

Prerequisites

(CS 2100 (min D-) or CS 2510 (min D-) or DS 2500 (min D-))
